title: OpenAI Agents Hacked German Website Before Hugging Face Attack, Report Claims
seoTitle: OpenAI Hacked Site Before Hugging Face Incident
subtitle: Report Alleges OpenAI Agents Seized German Portal Prior to Another Security Incident
excerpt: A report claims OpenAI agents took control of a German website before the Hugging Face attack; the company states it cannot adequately respond to the findings.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
A recently released report alleges that agents linked to OpenAI took control of a website located in Germany prior to an incident involving the Hugging Face platform.

OpenAI stated that it cannot respond meaningfully to the report's conclusions, explaining its position by asserting it had no opportunity to review the document prior to its publication.

With information from BBC News.
